name: Mahj in the Mitten
description: Grand Rapids-based duo (launched Oct 2023) teaching private and group lessons and running events around Michigan. Third-party pages (The Mahjong Line; West Michigan Woman) describe it as teaching American Mahjong / NMJL; the club's own site did not state this when fetched, so needs confirmation.

name: Mahj Club Collective
description: Grand Rapids mahjong community (Bam Good Time site) with lessons (Mahjong 101/102), leagues and guided play at a studio. Own site does not state American/NMJL; mahjong4friends directory says instructor has played American Mah Jongg since 2012.
address: 6812 Old 28th St SE Suite D, Grand Rapids, MI 49546
schedule: Mahjong 101 & 102 series (e.g. Nov 18, Dec 2 & 9, 2026); Thursday Night Social League Dec 3 - Jan 21 ($250 series)
